title: Microsoft Teams panels: hide the organiser name in Calendar View
summary: Hold: the licensing field says Microsoft has not published the model, although the setting is available with the licences already required for Teams panels. Licence purchasing information is also documented. Several assurances about the setting's wider effects go beyond Microsoft's description.

claims.claim: Teams panels gain an administrator setting named Show organizer name for Calendar View.
claims.quote: Admins can now choose whether the organizer name will show up in the Calendar View on Teams panels.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Governance guidance; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Turning Show organizer name off hides the organiser's name in Calendar View.
claims.quote: When organizer names are hidden, the organizer name is not shown in Calendar View on the panel device.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Administrators can change Show organizer name in the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal.
claims.quote: Admins can toggle the Show organizer name setting ON or OFF in the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal or on the panel device.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Administrators can change Show organizer name directly on a panel device.
claims.quote: The setting can be configured from the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal or directly on a Teams panel device.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The hiding control is admin-opt-in: organiser names remain visible unless an administrator changes the setting.
claims.quote: By default, organizer names will continue to be displayed in Calendar View.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters
claims.claim: Microsoft says no action is required to keep organiser names appearing.
claims.quote: No action is required if you want organizer names to continue appearing in Calendar View on Teams panel devices.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Microsoft asks administrators wanting to hide names to review room privacy and display requirements.
claims.quote: If you want to hide organizer names: - Review your room privacy and display requirements.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Microsoft asks administrators wanting to hide names to update the setting in the portal or on individual panels.
claims.quote: Update the Show organizer name setting in the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal or on individual Teams panel devices.

claims.where: What's changing; Cost and licensing; Scope
claims.claim: Microsoft's Teams panels release notes list the setting under October 2026.
claims.quote:
## October 2026

**Applies to:***Teams app version 1449/1.0.97.2026369007*

- **Hide the organizer's name in the calendar view**.

claims.claim: The release notes associate the change with Teams app version 1449/1.0.97.2026369007.
claims.quote: Applies to:Teams app version 1449/1.0.97.2026369007

claims.claim: Teams panels are touchscreen devices mounted outside meeting spaces.
claims.quote: Microsoft Teams panels are the compact touchscreen devices that are mounted right outside of your meeting spaces, typically next to entrances.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Scope; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The roadmap and release notes say the setting is available with Teams Rooms Pro and Teams Shared Space licences.
claims.quote: This feature is available with Teams Rooms Pro and Teams Shared Space licenses.

claims.claim: MC1484010 calls the qualifying licences Teams Rooms Pro and Teams Shared Spaces.
claims.quote: This feature is available with Teams Rooms Pro and Teams Shared Spaces licenses.

claims.claim: The licensing model is unknown, meaning Microsoft has not published it.
claims.quote: This feature is available with Teams Rooms Pro and Teams Shared Space licenses.
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to "included". The feature is available with Teams Rooms Pro and Teams Shared Space licences, which license the panels themselves; unknown pricing does not make that entitlement unknown. Retain the named licences in licensing.notes.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: The pages read for the briefing do not publish how the qualifying licences are bought or priced.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Pro Teams Shared Space license purchase pricing panels. Opened all four cited Learn pages: none supplies licence prices or a purchasing procedure. The separate Teams Rooms licenses and Teams Shared Space licensing pages do document purchasing.
claims.fix: Replace the narrow "in the pages read" purchasing gap in licensing.notes and Cost and licensing with "A separate price for this setting is not published." Remove the licence-pricing open question rather than suggesting that licence purchasing is undocumented. Purchasing guidance exists at https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/teams-add-on-licensing/teams-shared-device-license and https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/rooms/rooms-licensing.

claims.claim: The documented portal entry point for individual device settings is Rooms/ Phones > device > Settings.
claims.quote: Go to Rooms/ Phones in the left navigation and click the device you want to configure. 2. Select the Settings tab in the device panel.

claims.claim: The portal path to the general bulk device settings jobs control is Settings > Device Settings > Jobs.
claims.quote: In the left navigation of the Microsoft Teams Rooms Pro Management portal, go to Settings > Device Settings. 2. Select the Jobs tab.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no PowerShell, Graph or other API to change Show organizer name.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams panels Show organizer name PowerShell Microsoft Graph API; Teams PowerShell panel organizer; Graph teamworkDevice configuration. Opened MicrosoftTeams module index, teamworkDeviceConfiguration, release notes and Managing settings for Teams devices.

claims.claim: No API equivalent of the general bulk device settings jobs control is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Pro Management device settings jobs API PowerShell Graph. Opened Managing settings for Teams devices, MicrosoftTeams module index and teamworkDeviceConfiguration; no job-creation API or command was documented.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Configuring device settings in the Pro Management portal requires Rooms Management RBAC permissions.
claims.quote: you can configure settings for Microsoft Teams devices (Teams Rooms on Windows, Teams Rooms on Android, Teams Panels and Teams Phones), provided you have the necessary role-based access control permissions for Rooms Management.

claims.claim: The portal category containing Show organizer name is not documented in Learn.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams panels Show organizer name settings Calendar View Home screen. Opened release notes, Managing settings for Teams devices and Settings available for remote management; none names its portal category, and the Android list says documentation is coming soon.

claims.claim: Learn does not give the on-device path specifically to Show organizer name.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams panels Show organizer name settings Calendar View Home screen. Opened How to use Microsoft Teams panels and devices release notes; the former gives general admin-settings navigation, but neither gives this toggle's on-device path.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not specifically confirmed that bulk jobs or templates can apply Show organizer name.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Show organizer name jobs; Show organizer name Teams panels templates. Opened Managing settings for Teams devices, Settings available for remote management and release notes; bulk tools are documented generally, but this setting's bulk support is not specified.

claims.claim: The setting controls Calendar View only.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams panels Show organizer name settings Calendar View Home screen. Opened devices release notes and How to use Microsoft Teams panels; the setting is described for Calendar View, but no text rules out effects on other display elements.
claims.fix: Replace "The setting controls Calendar View only" with "Microsoft documents the setting's effect on Calendar View." Keep the following uncertainty about the Home screen tile; do not state an exclusive scope that the sources do not establish.

claims.claim: The Learn panels usage page describes the Home screen meeting-details tile as showing the meeting organiser's name.
claims.quote: It displays meeting title in prominent text, meeting start and end times, and meeting organizer's name.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated whether Show organizer name affects the Home screen meeting tile.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams panels Show organizer name settings Calendar View Home screen. Opened How to use Microsoft Teams panels, Teams panels overview and devices release notes; none states how this setting affects the Home screen meeting-details tile.

claims.claim: The setting adds no new data access.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams panels organizer data access; Show organizer name Teams panels permissions identity autonomous meeting changes. Opened panels overview and devices release notes; they describe display behaviour, not whether data access changes.
claims.fix: Remove "The setting adds no new data access or identity behaviour." Retain the documented Rooms Management permissions sentence.

claims.claim: The setting adds no new identity behaviour.
claims.quote: Searched: Show organizer name Teams panels permissions identity autonomous meeting changes. Opened devices release notes, panels overview and Managing settings for Teams devices; no passage states that identity behaviour is unchanged.
claims.fix: Remove "The setting adds no new data access or identity behaviour." Retain the documented Rooms Management permissions sentence.

claims.claim: The feature has no autonomous behaviour.
claims.quote: Searched: Show organizer name Teams panels permissions identity autonomous meeting changes. Opened devices release notes and Managing settings for Teams devices; Microsoft describes an administrator-controlled display setting, not a blanket absence of autonomous behaviour.
claims.fix: Replace "No autonomous behaviour: the setting is a display toggle that an admin sets per device" with "Admins choose whether to display organiser names using the Show organizer name setting in the portal or on a panel device."

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Administrators can configure the display setting on individual panel devices.
claims.quote: Update the Show organizer name setting in the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal or on individual Teams panel devices.

claims.claim: Portal device-setting changes are applied through jobs rather than immediately in real time.
claims.quote: Since setting changes from the Teams Rooms Pro management portal to the Teams device aren't in real-time, there will be a delay.

claims.claim: Apply Now queues a job to apply the setting.
claims.quote: Apply Now - Queues a job to apply the setting and restarts the device as soon as possible to apply the setting changes.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Apply Now restarts the device as soon as possible.
claims.quote: Apply Now - Queues a job to apply the setting and restarts the device as soon as possible to apply the setting changes.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Schedule Later applies the settings change during the nightly maintenance window.
claims.quote: Schedule Later - Schedules the settings change to be applied during the nightly maintenance window to avoid disrupting scheduled meetings during business hours.

claims.claim: A settings job can fail with DEVICE IN MEETING.
claims.quote: | Failed | DEVICE IN MEETING | Device is currently in a meeting. | Try again later. |

claims.claim: A settings job can fail because the device is disconnected.
claims.quote: | Failed | DEVICE DISCONNECTED | Device was disconnected when we attempted to execute the settings change, so no changes occurred. | Reapply the settings change. |

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Portal settings management is available only for signed-in devices.
claims.quote: Settings management is available only for signed-in devices. Ensure that the device is signed in for settings changes from the Teams Rooms Pro management portal to be applied successfully.

claims.claim: Settings changes made directly on the device are synchronised back to the portal.
claims.quote: Any setting changes made directly on the device are synchronized back to the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal and reflected in the Settings tab of the device panel

claims.claim: Settings Job History is under the Activity tab on the Rooms detail panel and shows the settings-change stage.
claims.quote: there's a Settings Job History activity under the Activity tab on the Rooms detail panel. This indicates the stage of settings change.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents no feature-specific meter, price or separate charge for this setting.
claims.quote: Searched: Show organizer name Teams panels price meter charge; Teams Rooms Pro Teams Shared Space license purchase pricing panels. Opened release notes, Teams panels, Teams Rooms licenses and Teams Shared Space licensing; none specifies a separate charge or meter for this setting.

claims.claim: Hiding the organiser name does not change the meeting itself.
claims.quote: Searched: Show organizer name Teams panels permissions identity autonomous meeting changes. Opened devices release notes and How to use Microsoft Teams panels; Microsoft describes hiding the name in Calendar View but does not state that the meeting itself is unchanged.
claims.fix: Remove "without changing the meeting itself" from the sentence. Keep the supported statement that the setting removes the organiser's name from Calendar View.

claims.claim: MC1484010 says the available information does not indicate support for managing the setting through Entra ID group membership.
claims.quote: The available information does not indicate support for management through Entra ID group membership.

claims.where: Governance guidance: After rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The governance checklist's Settings Job History monitoring step is represented in the controls table.
claims.quote: Check the Settings Job History under the Activity tab of each room to confirm the change completed. The table contains only the organiser-name setting and bulk device settings jobs.
claims.fix: The After rollout step "Check the Settings Job History under the Activity tab of each room to confirm the change completed" names a monitoring control that has no corresponding row in the controls table.
